paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: GPU Memory Cost. We apply all the experiments on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage in GB for various models. The x-axis represents the number of frames, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1000, and tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents memory usage in GB, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different model: VideoLLaMB (pink, dashed line), VideoLLaMB-R (brown, dashed line), PLLaVA (green, solid line), LLaVA-NeXT (blue, solid line), and VideoLLAVA (purple, solid line). The pink line for VideoLLaMB starts at around 20 GB at 0 frames and remains steady at approximately 20 GB at 500 frames. The brown line for VideoLLaMB-R begins at around 20 GB and remains steady at approximately 30 GB at 500 frames. The green line for PLLaVA starts at about 20 GB and increases to around 70 GB at 1000 frames. The blue line for LLaVA-NeXT begins at approximately 30 GB and rises to about 130 GB at 1000 frames. The purple line for VideoLLAVA starts at around 30 GB and sharply increases to approximately 430 GB at 300 frames.
